steps.name: Pure validation core greens its property suite
steps.description: Implement pure validation and upsert-resolution functions (range 30.0–250.0, 0.1 precision, skew-bound dates, closed rejection-reason set, apply_entry) until all 7 DISTILL validation properties pass.

steps.name: Pure trend core greens its property suite
steps.description: Implement Kalman forward + RTS backward smoother on the daily grid (ADR-004: R=0.20, q=R·α²/(1−α) with α=0.10, Huber δ=1.0, missing day = predict-only) until all 7 DISTILL trend properties pass.

Determinism and entry-order invariance; daily-grid coverage from first to last entry
Single-day +1.5 kg spike moves trend ≤0.3 kg; Huber bounds outliers of any magnitude
Gap crossed with bounded daily steps; 0.5 kg/week decline visible within 7 days

No parameter re-estimation — constants are versioned. Unskip only these 7 property tests. EXEMPT FROM PARADIGM: DISTILL-authored PBT properties are the unit-level coverage for this step.
